excerpt: In 2014, the XENON collaboration started the installation of XENON1T. XENON1T ran with a total of 3.2 tonnes from 2015 until 2018. In December 2018, the experiment was stopped for its upgrade to the next-generation experiment XENONnT. XENONnT started its operation with about 8.6 tonnes of xenon in 2020.
title: XENONnT experiment - History
